*Developers building LLM applications · 32 hours · level 3 · certification: professional*

| What | Where | Edit it |

## You will be able to

- Build a production-grade RAG system with evals
- guardrails and cost controls
- Apply every layer of the RAG stack deliberately
- Implement grounding
- citations
- refusal
- ACLs and injection defence

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_tokens_context_and_tools.py` | 1 | 20 | a request's context budget broken down line by line, what 5 vs 25 tool schemas cost on every call, and prompt patterns tested instead of believed |
| 2 | `02_ingestion_messy_documents.py` | 2 | 25 | layout-aware repair of a two-column text export, boilerplate and hidden-text removal, near-duplicate detection and metadata/ACL capture — with before/after retrieval |
| 3 | `03_chunking_strategies.py` | 3 | 25 | four chunking strategies compared on recall and tokens per answer — including parent-child retrieval (search small, read big) and the contextual prefix |
| 4 | `04_hybrid_retrieval_recall.py` | 4 | 25 | keyword vs meaning vs hybrid (RRF) vs hybrid+rerank scored with recall@1/3/8, MRR and nDCG on a labelled set — and the latency/cost of each stage |
| 5 | `05_query_and_grounded_generation.py` | 5 | 25 | a multi-turn conversation where follow-ups are rewritten into standalone queries, metadata filters are extracted, answers carry citations, out-of-scope is refused and a verifier checks faithfulness |
| 6 | `06_golden_set_ci_gate.py` | 6 | 25 | the full eval loop: golden set → retrieval + answer metrics → rubric judge checked against human labels → a CI gate that blocks a regression |
| 7 | `07_router_simple_rag_agent.py` | 7 | 25 | a three-way router with a registry of tools, budgets and termination, and the cost/latency of sending everything to the agent |
| 8 | `08_production_trace_and_cost.py` | 8 | 25 | one production request traced end to end — cache, ACL filter, injection scan, PII redaction, freshness check, tokens and cost per stage — plus a small cost dashboard |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
